deploy-bot: [AUTOMATIC] Release check failed -- embeddings route tokenization anomaly detected on v5.2.0 canary. Error rate for /embed increased to 0.9% (baseline 0.03%). Suggest auto-rollback to v5.1.8 for non-pinned traffic. Auto-rollback window: 3m. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/rollback-runbook
Maria: Wait  we have pilot customers pinned to this canary for model feedback. Please pause auto-rollback, do not revert pinned tenants.
Nikhil: Can we do a scoped rollback (hosted public) while leaving pilot/premium pools on 5.2.0? Need to confirm pinning support in the region.
Riley: ops-runner, can you confirm whether region-eu supports pool-level pinning? Also what's the change window? We're inside a 2h maintenance window that ends in 45m.
ops-runner: Confirmed: region-eu supports pool-level pin. We can pin dedicated-pilot and premium pools to 5.2.0. Hosted default route can be rolled back independently.
SupportBot: Notifying support rotation team via #support: "Heads-up: possible targeted rollback for embeddings regression; pilots unaffected" :bell:
Maria: Parallel actions proposed: 1) Apply immediate manual hold to stop auto rollback 2) Pin pilot & premium pools to 5.2.0 3) Start staggered rollback for hosted public to 5.1.8 in 10-minute waves 4) Update release notes and send customer blurb to pilots 5) Run verification traffic through canary after each wave
Nikhil: Agree. Small change: let's only roll back non-logged-in public traffic first (50%). If stable after 2 waves, move to 100%. Keeps risk low.
deploy-bot: CLI helpers: 
````
# pause auto-rollback (10m)
deployctl override --action=hold --by=Maria --expires=10m
# pin pools
deployctl pin --pool=dedicated-pilot --version=5.2.0
deployctl pin --pool=premium --version=5.2.0
# staged rollback for hosted public
deployctl rollback --scope=hosted-public --version=5.1.8 --batch=50% --wave=10m --reason="embed tokenization regression"
````
ops-runner: Running pin now for dedicated-pilot and premium. Will queue rollback waves but hold until verification ok by Maria/Nikhil.
Riley: Release notes draft: "Targeted rollback for embeddings route to address tokenization regression detected in canary. Affected: public hosted traffic. Pilot and premium customers remain on 5.2.0. ETA for full mitigation: under investigation." Posting to #release-notes for review.
Maria: Small edit: add support playbook link and mention maintenance window to the note. Also tag accounts-team to contact top 10 pilot customers.
Nikhil: Running smoke test against pinned pilot pool: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -sS -X POST https://eu.pilot.api.redwood/embed -d '{"text":"test"}' | jq '.status'; done` -> 20/20 OK. Tokenization anomaly not observed on pinned pool.
ops-runner: Rollback wave 1 (50%) initiated for hosted-public. Wave run-id: rb-7654321987-w1. Monitoring.
deploy-bot: Wave 1 complete  telemetry: public embed error rate down to 0.05%, p95 latency unchanged. No increase in other error classes.
Riley: Good. Proceed wave 2 (remaining 50%) in 10m if no regressions. Also post a short customer blurb for status.
Maria: After wave 2 completes, prepare a follow-up note with root-cause preliminary findings and next steps (hotfix/backport). Support, please prioritize any pilot tickets.
SupportBot: Support on standby. Creating incident tracker INC-7654321 and adding playbook link.
Nikhil: Agree on next: investigate tokenizer model commit diff between 5.2.0 and 5.1.8. Also schedule a quick postmortem after rollback finished.
ops-runner: Wave 2 started. run-id rb-7654321987-w2.
deply-bot (manual typo): just a quick lint check :grimacing:
Maria: lol noted.
deploy-bot: Wave 2 complete. Public error rate stable at baseline. Rollback considered successful. Manual hold expires; please release override when ready.
Riley: Release notes updated and published. Sending pilot comms now.
Maria: Leaving a note: do not auto-redeploy 5.2.0 until we have a validated hotfix and can validate in isolated pilot environment.
SupportBot: Pilot customers notified; support standby for escalations. Incident tracker updated with timeline and actions.
Nikhil: Scheduling RCA meeting in 48h. Adding a ticket for backport and test coverage for tokenizer edge cases.
ops-runner: Unlocking auto-rollback. Set sticky pin on pilot & premium pools for 24h.
Maria: Thanks team. Closing this thread after RCA invite goes out."
